name: NCR - Gurugram-Manesar corridor
story: Delhi NCR expansion belt between Dwarka Expressway and the Manesar industrial corridor; built-up land has grown rapidly since 2019.

products.title: Forest loss
products.description: Tree cover replaced by fields, bare land or construction.

products.title: Bare / mining expansion
products.description: Vegetated or agricultural land stripped to bare soil (mining, overburden dumps, excavation).

products.title: New water
products.description: Land became permanent water (reservoirs, subsidence pools).

products.title: Water loss
products.description: Water bodies replaced by land (drying, infilling, mining cut).
